entries.issue: Questions about the association, your assessment, or the neighborhood

entries.contact: DHOA office — the association contracts this out

entries.issue: A street light that is out
entries.note: Read the pole number off the metal plate on the light pole first — it is the fastest way to get the right light fixed.

entries.issue: A vehicle parked where it should not be, in a townhouse court
entries.note: Residents may not call the association's towing contractor directly. Try to find the owner first, then contact a Board member, who will arrange towing if it comes to that.

entries.issue: Vandalism, suspicious activity, or a noisy neighbor (non-emergency)
entries.contact: Frederick County Sheriff's Office, non-emergency dispatch

entries.issue: A party you believe involves underage drinking or drugs
entries.note: Give the address, date, and time. You are not required to give your name, and what you say is kept confidential.

entries.issue: A dog or cat running loose, an aggressive animal, or an animal in poor conditions
entries.note: Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 5:00 pm.

entries.issue: Snow removal on roads by single-family homes
entries.contact: Frederick County Office of Highway Operations
entries.note: After hours, call 301-600-1603. Every county road is a snow emergency route, so park in driveways rather than on the road or in cul-de-sacs.

entries.issue: A problem with a cluster mailbox
